android.desc:
Unlock the power of AI on every App that you use with Arc — your all-in-one AI Sidebar with AI writing assistant, AI summarizer, and productivity feature overlay that works inside every app.

Arc is a system-wide floating AI sidebar that lets you summarize, write, chat, extract text, and automate tasks without switching apps. Swipe from the edge — Arc's overlay appears on top of any app. Whether reading articles, replying to emails, studying, or on a call, Arc is your always-available AI copilot.

✍️ AI Writer — Smart Writing Anywhere
• My Info Vault: Store reusable info for personalized responses
• Create Post: Generate posts for Reddit, X, Instagram & product reviews
• Rewrite & Rephrase: Transform text into Professional, Polite, or Concise tones
• Fix Grammar: Correct spelling and grammar in one tap
• Smart AI Reply: Generate contextual replies for WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack & more
• Context-Aware: Arc understands your conversation for relevant help

📝 AI Summarizer
Beat information overload. Summarize articles, Reddit threads, PDFs & social media posts with one tap. Auto-detect category. Save, share & organize in your library. Works as a screen reader for long-form content.

💾 Save Content
Capture & save any on-screen text from any app. Auto-detect category, track source URL & app. Searchable library with filtering. Screenshot optional with privacy consent.

🎧 AI Call Insights
Turn phone call recordings into actionable intelligence. Two modes: Manual Upload & Auto Analysis. Generate summaries & full transcripts with speaker ID. Extract reminders, events, locations & phone numbers. One-tap: add to calendar, maps, contacts, or call.

⚡️ Smart Extract — OCR & Action Detection
Detect actionable info from any screen. Extract 8 item types: events, reminders, contacts, meeting links, locations, OTPs, phone numbers & emails. Copy text from any screen — even apps that don't allow selection. Detect spam, scams & loan fraud warnings.

🎓 Flashcard Generator
Create flashcards from on-screen content. AI generates questions, hints & answers. Preview before saving. Interactive study mode with progress tracking. Perfect for students & quick revision.

💬 Chat With Your Screen — AI Chatbot
Ask questions about anything on your screen. Attach screenshots for visual analysis & image recognition. Resume conversations from your organized chat history. An AI chatbot that sees your screen.

⚡️ Custom & Community Actions
Create unlimited Custom Actions
